lines: Our love story.
It unfolded just as I’d imagined, with yearning.
Now, when it begins, it’s a one‑person play.
Even if I stay by your side forever,
in the end I’m merely an audience member.
A feelingless sorry.
It’s the same as always.
Once I get used to it, it isn’t bad, though.
Our romance is just a pattern of life.
I’ve learned it won’t continue.
If only I could meet in a different setting, a different relationship,
I wish I could have chosen another world line.
If only I had a different personality, a different set of values,
It would be nice to be able to convey love, but wishing that is futile.
Good‑bye.
I’m not the person destined for you.
It’s painful, yet undeniable, and still hard to let go.
Just touching your hair hurts.
Even if it’s bitter, it’s sweet—no, no.
Good‑bye.
Then, what am I to you?
I don’t know the answer, and I don’t want to know.
If there is one thing I can be sure of,
‘You are beautiful.’
Someone pompously
talks about the logic of love,
but nothing ever clicks.
From an airplane window looking down,
it’s like the nightscape of an unfamiliar city.
If only I could meet in a different setting, a different relationship,
I wish I could have chosen another world line.
With a purely sincere heart, I embrace the love that came true.
It would be nice to irresponsibly say ‘I love you.’
Even wishing that feels empty.
Good‑bye.
Beyond the hands we held lies the end line.
Each time we stretch it, the future that throbs…
You’re not there, and that fact makes me cry…
That’s certainly painful.
Good‑bye.
I’m not the person destined for you.
It’s painful, yet undeniable, and still hard to let go.
Just touching your hair hurts.
Even if it’s bitter, it’s sweet—no, no.
Good‑bye.
Then, what am I to you?
I don’t know the answer, and I don’t want to know.
If there is one thing I can be sure of,
‘You are beautiful.’
If all of this is the fate of romance, it isn’t bad at all.
There is no eternity nor promise,
‘You are very beautiful.’
